com.articulate.sigma.trans.SUMOKBtoTPTPKB.FormulaResult
Enclosing class:
SUMOKBtoTPTPKB
private static final class SUMOKBtoTPTPKB.FormulaResult extends Object
Per-formula translation result for the parallel formula loop. Translation data (expensive) is computed in parallel; dedup/write is sequential.
